resolved_findings.resolution: The guide and report limit the workflow to text annotations, promise atomic refusal of unsupported returned images/structures, and explicitly state that Zotero can substitute a notice or omit unavailable content before Quds receives it. No selected-type validation is claimed.

report_and_replay.note: Replay commands were checked against argument definitions and the committed source/plan identities; this documentation review did not rerun tests.

acceptance_scope.installed_application_claims: The report explicitly excludes a fresh live Zotero session, installed OS shortcut acceptance, actual Word/LibreOffice reopening, and installed older-version acceptance.
acceptance_scope.controlled_older_version_scope: The older-version failure coverage is correctly identified as a model of the inspected native STOP-error callback.
acceptance_scope.development_counts_excluded: Exploratory counts and corrected early expectations remain separate from the final frozen totals.
